concrete_decision: Retain the approved first OS/profile. Do not select an ARI/QMI adapter or switch to a later eSIM-capable identity before inspecting actual selected-image components. Continue independent transport/library host preparation.

primary_findings.finding: Public eSIM requirements start with XS/XR; this flags a hardware/profile gap, not software impossibility.
Public provisioning entry point is carrier-app restricted and uses a fine-grained CommCenter entitlement; it is not selected private/system frontend ABI evidence.
Intel ARI protocol/structure-extraction methodology is available, with later-OS documentation inconsistency; selected16.5 tables were not recovered.
Author still labels profile provisioning unverified; an incomplete Settings page and host models do not establish provisioning.
XS/XR/A12-capable references support arm64e; switching image identity additionally requires actual architecture/PAC/loader ABI checks.

required_external_inputs: Explicit selected iOS16.5 image/build/product manifest and acquisition provenance
Matching CommCenter, relevant baseband libraries/plugins, shared-cache and entitlement inputs with source/extraction hashes
Selected-image frontend/service/private ABI and actual Samsung command schemas before adapter selection
limits: No selected-image component presence/absence claim from documentation or missing standalone paths
No current Apple SDK, later OS table or Qualcomm model substituted for actual selected16.5 inputs
No Apple binary, private trace, identifier or activation code published
